title: Punjab Revision of Medical Facilities of Public Representatives Act 2006

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Revision of Medical Facilities of Public Representatives Act 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XV OF 2006
ACT XV OF 2006
PUNJAB
REVISION OF MEDICAL FACILITIES OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ACT, 2006
An Act to revise the medical facilities of the holders of
representative offices of the Province of the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, dated 2nd November, 2006]
No.PAP-Legis-2(39)/2006/878, dated 2-11-2006.---The
Punjab Revision of Medical Facilities of Public Representatives Bill 2006,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 9th October,
2006, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 31st October, 2006, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient to extend
the medical facilities to the parents of holders of representative offices of
the Province of the Punjab;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act
may be cited as the Punjab Revision of Medical Facilities of Public
Representatives Act, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

No.PAP-Legis-2(39)/2006/878, dated 2-11-2006.---The
Punjab Revision of Medical Facilities of Public Representatives Bill 2006,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 9th October,
2006, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 31st October, 2006, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient to extend

the Province of the Punjab;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
3. Amendment in Act XLI of 1975.---In the Punjab Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (XLI of 1975) section 14 shall
be substituted by the following:--
"14. Medical
facilities.---A Minister shall be entitled for
himself and for his parents, spouse, real and step sons and daughters, wholly
dependent upon him, to medical facilities admissible in terms of the Special
Medical Attendance Rules, 1950."

6. Amendment in Ordinance LXXI of 2002.-- In the Punjab Parliamentary Secretaries (Salary,
Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002 (LXXI of 2002), section 13 shall be
substituted by the following:
"13. Medical
